visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of an Asian woman with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a black lace-trimmed top, speaking directly to the camera against a dark, out-of-focus studio background. (2) A close-up shot transitions to a medical skincare device being pressed against the jawline of a patient; white-gloved hands hold the bulky grey and white handle. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman in the studio, emphasizing her points with hand gestures and subtle facial expressions. (4) A quick transition shows a different treatment, where a device emits a bright orange-red light onto a patient's face covered in clear gel. (5) Returning to the woman, she continues her explanation, looking professional and authoritative while the lighting remains consistent and bright on her face. (6) A technical close-up shows the 'Tech Gua Sha' probe, a flat metal head, being used on a patient's jaw and chin area with gel. (7) A sequence of shots follows, including treatment around the eye area and another close-up of the woman demonstrating the lifting effect by touching her own face. (8) The woman demonstrates the 'Swan Neck' effect by touching her neck and showing the jawline contour. (9) Final shot of the woman speaking with high energy, looking at the camera. (10) The video ends with a white graphic screen displaying the clinic's logo, contact number, and address information.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to compare two medical skincare treatments, 'Tech Gua Sha' and 'BBL', explaining their different mechanisms (heat vs. light) and results (fat reduction/lifting vs. routine maintenance). It positions the speaker as an expert to build trust and ultimately promote the DRX Dermatology Clinic's services.
